startersHint: A starter picks the board, its shape, the pen thickness and whether your voice is recorded. Tap Try a sample drawing to see something on the board straight away.
unsupported: This browser cannot record the board. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. You can still draw without recording.
boardHint: Draw with your finger, a pen or the mouse. Everything you draw is in the video, so draw as you talk.
shapeHint: Changing the shape clears the board.
voiceHint: Uses your microphone. Your browser asks for permission.
recordHint: Start recording, then draw and talk. Pause when you need a break, and stop to save the video.
denied: The microphone could not be opened. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, or turn off Record my voice.
failed: The video could not be saved. Try again.
tooShort: The recording was too short to save. Record for a few seconds and try again.
mp4Note: Saved as an MP4 file that plays on phones, computers and WhatsApp.
webmNote: Saved as a WebM file because this browser cannot record MP4. It plays in most browsers; use the Video Compressor and Trimmer to make an MP4 if you need one.
notSaved: Your drawing and recording stay on this device and are never uploaded. Only your starter choices are remembered in this browser.
